A '''[[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]''' was located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Gang leaders [[Lemo]] and [[Sanda]] were incarcerated there after being captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in the [[Keyorin system/Legends|Keyorin system]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traveled to the asteroid prison to obtain information on the location of a [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]] statue Lemo and Sanda had in their possession.

{{Ast-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Though the Belderone sector is not mentioned by name, its location is ascertainable because Han Solo said the asteroid is in the same sector as the Keyorin system.
